name: Superconduction / head

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. A pumpkin-like head bursts: loud wet hollow pop, shell crunch, broad pulp splatter. Continue with dense falling wet droplets beneath a sustained icy high electrical singing whistle and fine crystalline ticks for 3.5 seconds. Fade only in the last 0.3 seconds. No voice, scream, music, gunshot or reverb.
